items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: I can remember Bill Thrillkill and Chick Bailey, she's a girl she's passed on to.

ctx.x: Then? Do you remember anybody there? I can remember Bill Thrillkill and Chick Bailey, she's a girl she's passed on to. Was she also a singer?
Yes, she was a singer. What did Thrillkill do?
